cell.finfet_note: ASAP7 (GPurify generic_finfet.deck, DRM 1p7): fins 7 nm at a 27 nm pitch, gates exactly 20 nm at a 54 nm pitch; S/D contacted through SDT + LISD and V0 to M1, gates through LIG and V0. Channel width is a fin count; L is the fixed gate width. The deck connects M1 and up only and recognises no devices: LVS covers routing, not devices.
